current_schema_audit.w014_lineage_status: public.geography_entity_lineage already supports entity_type='mandal' (expanded in Migration 043)

stable_identity_evaluation.finding: public.mandals.id (TEXT PRIMARY KEY) provides sufficient stable anchor identity to support mandals -> mandal_versions without altering W013 identity semantics.
stable_identity_evaluation.rationale: Mirrors state_versions where state_code (TEXT PK of states) is referenced directly. Mandals id is immutable, referenced across all domain tables (mcm, gram_panchayats, polling_booths), and requires zero structural changes.

columns.name: mandal_id
columns.type: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.mandals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.name: district_id
columns.type: UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.districts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

columns.type: TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.dataset_versions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: uq_mandal_versions_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (mandal_id WITH =, (daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)')) WITH &&)

constraints.name: chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants
constraints.definition: CHECK ((is_current = false) OR (is_current = true AND valid_to IS NULL))

proposed_additions: ADD COLUMN current_version_id UUID REFERENCES public.mandal_versions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
ADD COLUMN is_current BOOLEAN DEFAULT true

temporal_and_lineage_semantics.interval_rules: Valid intervals [valid_from, valid_to) are half-open. Overlapping intervals for the same mandal_id are strictly prohibited by GiST exclusion. Contiguous adjacent intervals (e.g. [2016-10-11, 2022-09-01) and [2022-09-01, NULL)) are fully permitted.

lifecycle_transitions.rename: New version record inserted with updated name, valid_from set to Gazette notification date; previous version updated with valid_to and is_current=false.
lifecycle_transitions.creation: New mandals anchor inserted; initial mandal_version created with valid_from=effective_date, valid_to=NULL, is_current=true.
lifecycle_transitions.split: Predecessor mandal_version closed (valid_to assigned); successor mandal versions created; lineage recorded in public.geography_entity_lineage with transition_type='split'.
lifecycle_transitions.merge: Predecessor mandal versions closed; unified successor version created; lineage recorded in public.geography_entity_lineage with transition_type='merge'.
lifecycle_transitions.abolition: Active mandal_version closed with statutory abolition date (valid_to assigned, is_current=false); anchor is_current set to false.

snapshot_589_reconciliation.version_representation: Each of the 589 mandals has a historical mandal_versions row with valid_from='2016-10-11', valid_to='2022-09-01', is_current=false.
snapshot_589_reconciliation.geometry_attachment: entity_geometries.mandal_version_id references this exact historical mandal_version UUID.
snapshot_589_reconciliation.blocker_treatment_23_mandals: The 23 post-2016 mandals did not exist during the 2016 snapshot. They possess NO historical version row for [2016-10-11, 2022-09-01). They remain UNKNOWN / BLOCKED for geometry (UNK-16-01). No synthetic polygons or inferred aggregation mappings are created in statutory tables.

preservation_of_adjacent_layers.w015_relational_primacy: public.mandal_constituency_map and public.polling_booths continue referencing public.mandals(id) stable anchor. Zero schema or query changes to W015.
preservation_of_adjacent_layers.w012_data_governance: mandal_versions links to dataset_versions via primary_dataset_version_id; provenance DAG records ingest/transition nodes. No duplicate governance structures.
preservation_of_adjacent_layers.scenario_isolation: Scenario mandal projections (if any) are isolated via separate dataset_versions (source_authority='synthetic_model') with is_current=false, strictly separated from statutory legal versions.
